fields.why: The headline claim is annual death counts (mean 4.1 vs 13.0 per year, no denominator); the brief puts 'counts' under binary/categorical but 'incidence' under count/rate, so both lists are defensible. Rule needed: event counts per unit time in a series are count/rate.

The outcome is perioperative death after cosmetic surgery ('intraoperative and postoperative complications'), which 'other acute' captures; cardiovascular covers only the embolic causes (18 of 20 autopsied).
The brief says age (and sex, same rule) are recorded always; the text reports 'all but one occurred in women' and mean decedent age 40. Level 0 is unaffected.

brief_issues: Both readers quote 'Timing of death › Death within 24 hours' as comparison evidence, which is off point. The brief should say whether annual event counts without a denominator are count/rate or binary/categorical.
